question: Does the level-reaction edge (real reject rate minus the matched random-level rate) differ between groups of sessions defined by facts known before 09:30 ET?

outcome.source: studies/level_reaction/v2.json (rules, baseline and seed unchanged; gexpro/reaction_lab.py)
outcome.per_session: per market, pooled over all level types: (real rejects, real touches, baseline rejects, baseline touches); touches exclude at_open, gap_through, untouched, no_prior_close and dependent levels
outcome.group_value: pooled real reject rate minus pooled baseline reject rate over the group's sessions
outcome.note: pooling over types: the baseline is type-matched per draw, but its mix of types per session follows the draws, not the real touches

unit: the session (one market, one trading day); sessions whose split input is unavailable are left out of that split and counted

splits.input: the frozen plan's regime (snapshot before 09:30); any other value: unavailable
|plan ref - plan zero gamma| / plan expected move, all index prices from the frozen plan; near < 0.5, far >= 0.5; no zero gamma: unavailable

VXN (NQ) or VIX (ES) close of the previous trading day (Cboe daily history); cutoffs: the 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles (linear interpolation) of the 252 closes ending that previous day; low <= q1 < mid <= q2 < high; fewer than 252 closes: unavailable

the archive's calendar.json for the day (ForexFactory, last copy fetched before 09:30 ET): event if it lists a USD High-impact item dated that day (ET); CPI, FOMC, NFP and PCE are named on the row (titles containing CPI; FOMC or Federal Funds Rate; Non-Farm Employment Change; PCE); no copy, or a copy whose events are all outside that day's Sunday-Saturday week: unavailable
the Monday-Friday week holding that month's expiry: the third Friday, moved to the previous trading day on a holiday (gexsys/marketcal.py)

the archive's {M}-open.json: by_dte_bucket 0DTE abs / sum of abs over all buckets; cutoffs: the 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles of up to 252 earlier archived sessions' shares of the same market, at least 60; low <= q1 < mid <= q2 < high; fewer than 60 earlier: unavailable

test.statistic: S = sum over groups of n_g x (d_g - d_bar)^2, n_g = the group's sessions, d_g = the group value, d_bar = the n-weighted mean of d_g
test.null: group labels shuffled across the split's sessions (whole sessions keep their counts), 10,000 permutations, seed 20261118 + the test's position in this list (0-13: splits in order, NQ then ES)
test.p_value: (1 + permutations with S >= observed S) / (counted permutations + 1); a permutation where a group has no real or no baseline touch is not counted; over 10% not counted: the test is unavailable
test.not_enough_data: any group of the split with fewer than 20 sessions: not tested, shown as not enough data with each group's n
test.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.10 across the tests actually run; the registered count (14) and the tested count are both shown

report.survivors: each group's difference with the Phase 4 interval (gexpro/uncertainty.py, 10,000 session resamples, seed 20261118), n sessions per group
report.others: no difference found, with each group's n and difference
report.roll_weeks: included; the count of roll-week sessions in each test is shown

look_ahead: every input is known before the session's 09:30 ET: plan snapshot time (L1), previous-day vol close, calendar copy fetched before 09:30 (A3), open snapshot before 09:30 (A3); tools/stress/lookahead_audit.py L8 checks the split inputs
